messages:
anna: Heads-up — we're seeing persistent GPU fragmentation in ap-southeast1 since ~04:00 UTC. Many small pods stuck pending, then kubelet attach retries cause evictions. Any quick wins before we start a big repro?
ben: I saw that too. conntrack slab allocs spike in the same window, and we have attach/detach flapping on a subset of racks. Suspect network namespace churn + NVLink warm nodes amplify churn.
carlos: Can you paste the kubelet logs for one of the failed attaches? I want to check attach timeout vs csi-controller errors.
anna: pasted minimal excerpt: ```kubelet: attach failed: timeout waiting for device mount, Err: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded context deadline exceeded```
tess: @carlos fwiw, infra monitoring shows 5xx from our attach-proxy in that AZ around the same time. Might be conntrack exhaustion on the attach-proxy nodes.
ben: If attach-proxy is rejecting, pods go into crashloop/eviction and scheduler ends up placing many tiny GPU jobs across nodes -> binpacking fragment. Cost spike follows because we start spinning warm nodes.
anna: Proposal: temporary enforcer — set scheduler annotation to prefer binpack on GPU nodes for small pods, and add a taint on attach-proxy-pool to avoid new mounts while we heal. Quick config patch: ```kubectl patch configmap scheduler-config -n kube-system --type merge -p '{"data":{"policy":"+binpack: gpu-prefer=true"}}'``` (mock example)
carlos: I don't love changing scheduler config at runtime without a canary. Alternative: set a mutating webhook to add nodeSelector/affinity for new jobs from the affected queue so they prefer co-locating. Less global risk.
tess: We should also throttle warm-node scale-up to avoid cost runaway. If many small jobs keep failing, autoscaler will keep adding nodes and we'll pay for unused gpus. Can we cap burst capacity for the ap-southeast1-b pool?
ben: Yes — bumping burst limit to 0 temporarily for that pool would stop churn. I'll open a quick autoscaler patch.
anna: Short-term steps then: 1) cordon attach-proxy nodes for maintenance (avoid new mounts) 2) deploy mutating webhook that prefers binpack affinity for small GPU jobs (alpha) 3) throttle autoscaler burst for ap-southeast1-b 4) collect sample kubelet+attach logs and a pod list for postmortem
carlos: I'll take logs + a script to map pending pods -> node footprints (will run in 10m).
tess: I'm on autoscaler patch now. Will keep burst cap at 1 until we confirm attach-proxy is healthy.
infra-bot: deploy-bot started patch rollout: autoscaler-config@ap-southeast1 (change: burst_limit=1). Monitor: https://grafana.redwood/infracluster/ap-southeast1/metrics
ben: After patch, keep an eye on tokenized metrics: conntrack_count, attach_proxy_5xx, kubelet_attach_retries. If they don't trend down within 30m we'll revert binpack preference.
anna: Filed an incident stub and added checklist. If anyone spots scheduler misbehavior ping here and I'll roll back the webhook. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
